title: Subscription Operation
description: Whether the Business accepts an operation through this capability now, and where the buyer can do it instead when it does not.

available.description: `true` when the Business accepts the operation now from a caller authorized to perform it; independent of the scopes the caller holds. `false` when the operation applies but the Business does not accept it through this capability now; a `messages[]` entry whose `path` names this operation says why.

continue_url.description: Where the buyer can perform the operation on the Business's site. Only when `available` is `false`; required on `update_payment`.
